description: Victorian paraffin (oil) table lamp, lit, 0.60 m: stepped brass foot, turned brass column with beads, round brass font, burner with a pierced gallery and a side wick-winder knob, opal (milk-glass) globe shade, tall clear glass chimney. Tarnished brass, polished where handled. The globe glows warm and a flame burns in the chimney (emissive). Unlit twin: lamp_oil_table_01.
